categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of permanent ferrite new functional magnetic materials, including high-performance wet-pressed ferrite magnetic tiles. It also develops soft magnetic materials and devices, micro-inverters, and related components. Key business segments include magnetic materials, micro-inverters and accessories, and commutators and other products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced ceramic processing methods for manufacturing permanent ferrite materials, including wet-pressing and sintering technologies. It has proprietary technologies in raw material preparation, magnetic circuit optimization, forming, and sintering. The company also focuses on automation and integrated equipment innovation to improve production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in the automotive, variable frequency home appliances, electric tools, fitness equipment, photovoltaic, energy storage, and new energy vehicle sectors. The company serves major global manufacturers including Bosch, Valeo, Nidec, LG, and Haier, with products used in micro motors, inverters, and charging piles.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover domestic China and international markets including Europe, Asia-Pacific, North America, and Latin America. The company has sales centers in Hefei, Shanghai, Frankfurt (Germany), Osaka (Japan), and San Luis Potosi (Mexico). It also has manufacturing subsidiaries in Vietnam, Thailand, Germany, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the magnetic materials supply chain, producing core magnetic components such as ferrite magnetic tiles and soft magnetic cores used in downstream electronic components and devices like micro motors and inverters.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening technology innovation in permanent ferrite and soft magnetic materials, expanding production capacity to surpass global competitors like TDK, and developing a full soft magnetic industry chain. R&D focuses on high-performance ferrite materials, sensor magnets, motor magnets, soft magnetic materials with low loss and high frequency, and automation in production equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of magnetic materials, micro-inverters, commutators, and related electronic components. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with customized production aligned to customer contracts and direct billing upon product acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the largest domestic producers of permanent ferrite wet-pressed magnetic tiles and a leading global supplier in automotive and variable frequency appliance sectors. It competes with international firms like Japan's TDK and has established a strong market position through technological leadership, scale, and long-term partnerships with major global manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.17 billion, a 9.33% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111 million, up 50.31%. Total assets reached RMB 2.29 billion, reflecting steady growth and expanding scale. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, standardized, and consistent magnetic materials with advanced performance metrics close to or surpassing international benchmarks. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology, scale economies, cost advantages from production bases in lower-cost regions, and strong customer service with rapid response and customization capabilities. The company also leverages its brand reputation and long-term relationships with leading global customers.
